ModMetaData.name: Neat Edges
ModMetaData.author: MrBeverage
ModMetaData.description:
RimWorld fades its terrain tiles into its neighbors, making your floors look like they are dissolving at the rim. Neat Edges allows you just that, hard borders between tiles, trimmed or untrimmed, to suit whatever appearance or build you like.
Meant to replace Perspective: Paths. Neat Edges provides the same hard edge zones, in addition to its standalone edges, and trim pieces.
· Hard edge areas: whole tiles, painted as an area. Free to place, and not only prevents terrain from fading into a tile, but also prevents the tile from fading into its neighbors. · Hard edges: the same, but for specific edges of a single tile. Also free. · Floor borders: trim pieces in wood, stone, or metals that take paint. Straight edges, corners, runners, end caps, frames, and corner pieces. Each piece hardens the edges it covers.
Where edges meet, corners are sealed too so runs end square without terrain fringes. An overlay toggle exists in the bottom-right cluster of map toggles to reveal the zones and hard edges.
If you already have Perspective: Paths, just add Neat Edges, remove it, and load your save. The areas painted in Perspective: Paths come back as Neat Edges hard edge zones, tile for tile, with its painting tools in the Zone tab right where they used to be. The original and continued versions of Perspective: Paths save the same way, so both carry over. If you keep it installed instead, Neat Edges yields on hard edge areas, keeping singular hard edges and floor borders.
Warning: removing Perspective: Paths on its own is not safe as it adds its zone to every map, painted or not, the game gives no way to delete it, and a save that still holds one loses the map's whole area list, home area included.
Works with any floor from any mod, keeps Dub's Paint Shop colors, and works alongside vanilla bridges. Requires Harmony. You can add it to a running save, but before removing it, use Clear hard edge area on every map you painted. A save that still holds the area loses the map's whole area list, home area included, and clearing the last painted tile removes the area itself. Markers and borders can stay; RimWorld drops each one with a load error, and floors and terrain are untouched.
Other mods can make their own decorations harden edges through the extension the floor borders carry, with no dependency beyond a MayRequire.
Recommended with: · Flooring Floors. Neat Edges provides borders, but no floors of its own, and this mod adds hundreds, in all materials, and expands on its limited set of border pieces. · Dub's Paint Shop. Neat Edges' border pieces are all paintable, so add some color to builds!
The painted area follows Owlchemist's Perspective: Paths, which solved the whole-tile case first.
MIT licensed, with the design notes and a regression harness in the repository. Written with AI assistance.
